notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 9.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Angelic Enforcer.
Mayael's Aria then triggers, gaining you ten life, causing Angelic Enforcer's power to be at least twenty.
Mayael's Aria triggers, winning you the game.
